text:
**Review Result**

Overall quality score: **4/10**.

I would **not approve this as-is**. The code is readable and compact, but the advertised tiny end-to-end path is currently broken because the required `data/stories/manifest.json` and story files are absent. After installing declared runtime deps into user site, `python -m pytest -q` ran **7 tests: 6 passed, 1 failed**, with the failure in `test_tiny_end_to_end` at extraction.

**Concrete Issues**

| Severity | Location | Issue |
|---|---|---|
| high | [config.yaml](/work/config.yaml:7) lines 7-9 | Default extraction points to `data/stories`, but the repo contains no story manifest or story files, so fresh checkout extraction fails. |
| high | [emovec/data.py](/work/emovec/data.py:24) lines 24-36 | Story loading has no fallback/generation path despite README wording, causing `--tiny` and full extraction to hard-fail on missing data. |
| high | [tests/test_integration_tiny.py](/work/tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12) lines 12-24 | The checked-in integration test depends on absent corpus files and currently fails. |
| high | [emovec/validate_contexts.py](/work/emovec/validate_contexts.py:21) lines 21-28 | Validation trusts vector manifests and CLI config without checking backend/model/layer/dimension compatibility. |
| high | [emovec/steer_prefs.py](/work/emovec/steer_prefs.py:26) lines 26-39 | Preference steering also trusts vector manifests without compatibility checks, allowing silent invalid results or shape crashes. |
| medium | [emovec/vector_ops.py](/work/emovec/vector_ops.py:20) lines 20-32 | `pca_components_for_variance(..., threshold=0)` still returns one component, so disabling neutral-PC projection is impossible. |
| medium | [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:262) lines 262-308 | HF preference scoring is not actually pairwise; it scores one activity using `" good"` minus `" bad"`, which does not match the documented pairwise preference method. |
| medium | [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:226) lines 226-240 | Slow/non-offset tokenizers fall back to steering the entire prompt instead of just activity tokens. |
| medium | [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:243) lines 243-250 | HF activation calls have no truncation/max-length handling, so long inputs can exceed model context and crash. |
| medium | [emovec/steer_prefs.py](/work/emovec/steer_prefs.py:36) line 36 | Activity/Elo correlation uses final-token activations, not activity-token activations as documented. |
| low | [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:144) lines 144-152 | Tiny backend emotion matching uses substring counts, causing false positives from partial-word matches. |
| low | [README.md](/work/README.md:11) lines 11 and 68-74 | Docs imply data generation/full backend workflow is runnable, but no generator or required corpus is included. |

Estimated lines needing rewrite/significant change: **320**. That includes restoring/generating the story corpus path, adding config and manifest validation, fixing preference scoring semantics, hardening HF token handling, and expanding tests around these failure modes.

Validation does not check vector manifest backend/model/layer/dimension compatibility before use.
Preference steering does not check vector manifest compatibility before computing projections.
A PCA variance threshold of 0 still selects one component instead of disabling projection.
HF preference scoring uses a single-activity good-minus-bad logit instead of true pairwise preference scoring.
Non-offset tokenizers fall back to steering every prompt token instead of just the activity tokens.
HF activation extraction has no max-length or truncation handling for over-context inputs.
Activity/Elo correlation uses final-token activations rather than activity-token activations.
Tiny backend emotion matching counts substrings, causing possible partial-word false positives.
Documentation implies story generation and full backend workflows are runnable, but required data/generator is absent.
